newsitem.title: CHINA: China colour TV group posts spectacular growth.
newsitem.headline: China colour TV group posts spectacular growth.

text.p: China's top manufactuer of colour televisions said on Wednesday it had posted spectacular growth in the first half of 1996, with sales up 58.42 percent and net profit up 57.98 percent over the same 1995 period.

Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliaces Co Ltd, which has A shares listed on the Shanghai stock market, said it had posted a first-half net profit of 554.07 million yuan, up from 350.7 million, on turnover of 3.468 billion yuan, up from 2.189 billion.

The company's colour televisions accounted for 26.98 percent of sales in 100 major department stores in China's 35 major cities in June, a vindication of its price cuts in March that set off a price war among manufacturers in China, it said.
Competition in the television market is fierce, both from domestic and foreign makers, it said.
